import_provenance.original_title: Compact general-circuit homomorphic secret sharing from DDH
import_provenance.original_statement: Can the decisional Diffie–Hellman assumption yield two-party, one-private additive homomorphic secret sharing for arbitrary polynomial-size circuits, with output shares whose size is independent of the evaluated circuit? Existing DDH constructions support restricted computations, while general-circuit constructions use stronger tools such as fully homomorphic encryption.
import_provenance.supplied_caveat: Remark: Editorial specialization of the paper’s explicit question about general-circuit HSS under assumptions beyond those supporting FHE.
